capture_rule: Capture the complete primary article and every row, column, note, uncertainty and source-defined condition in Table 2, which reports measured OH plus dimethyl-ether rate coefficients together with flow density. Preserve every table row in source order and retain repeated temperature classes. Do not select or omit any row by density, rate, trend or agreement, and do not fit an exponent.
source_selection_boundary: The primary-source identity, complete Table 2 boundary and all table-row ordinals are fixed before executable-law registration, candidate enumeration or prediction-program construction. The source is selected structurally because one complete openly accessible primary measurement table jointly reports density and rate coefficient with uncertainties. No observed row value selects the source, table or law.
